information: Welcome to the Pacific Northwest! [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa2xBIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--740c53d289def878faa5292856a4438109c059dc/image.png)](https://www.facebook.com/groups/pnwcubing) * [Visit our **webpage**](https://www.pnwcubing.com) * [See our **upcoming competitions**](https://www.pnwcubing.com/competitions) * [Join our **Facebook community**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085) * [Follow us on **Instagram**](https://www.instagram.com/pnwcubing/) * [Join our **Discord**](https://discord.gg/39HzT57upV) Warm Up Seattle 2025 is an exciting event for both attendees of the World Championships 2025 and folks who are not able to attend the championship. This competition is a **favorites** competition where you may register for up to 6 events (FTO does not count towards this limit). By registering for this competition, you should be aware of the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) and this specific competitions [Competitor Responsibilites](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WarmUpSeattle2025#52996-please-read-competitor-responsibilities-schedule-explanation).
